messages.subject: Tags and HTML
parts:
Hello, I'm having trouble with tags and HTML in my program.  Any help would be appreciated.

1.  the HTML line does not display my image even though it is available in a subdirectory called www in the shinyapps folder. I just get the question mark.

2.  The output$textbox2 lines (either place) do not update the tags$textarea text from "abc" to "123".

Thanks in advance.


library("shiny")
runApp(list(
  ui = fluidPage(           
  tags$textarea(id="textbox2",  rows=3, cols=140, "abc"),
  HTML('<img src="chuck.png"/>'), "My Title")
  ,
  
  server = function(input, output, session){
    
    output$textbox2 <- renderPrint({
      "123"
      })

    
    observe({
      output$textbox2 <- renderPrint({
        "123"
      })
    })
  }

))
